lines.speaker: Mesha Gate-Scribe
lines.text: The Gate has begun to breathe under dead stone. That is not reopening. That is distress.

lines.speaker: Mesha Gate-Scribe
lines.text: Send Titans, not hope. Hope leaves no footprint on a cracked seal.

lines.speaker: Mesha Gate-Scribe
lines.text: This tablet held seven thousand gate-signs yesterday. Today it holds six thousand nine hundred and ninety-nine. The missing sign has not been erased. It has been eaten.

lines.speaker: Hollow Presence
lines.text: Name given. Name taken. Shape remains.

lines.speaker: Mesha Gate-Scribe
lines.text: Do not answer it with fear. Fear is still a form of offering.

lines.speaker: Hrodda Oath-Witness
lines.text: The first step is not across the bridge. The first step is deciding what your word weighs.

lines.speaker: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
lines.text: The arena does not hate the unworthy. It simply refuses to pretend.

lines.speaker: Forgotten Banner
lines.text: I was raised by hands both courts deny. Let them deny the blood next.

lines.speaker: Maeve Root-Memory
lines.text: Walk lightly. Not because the ground is fragile. Because it is listening.

lines.speaker: Maeve Root-Memory
lines.text: The Beast Realms do not invade. They arrive where appetite has already been invited.

lines.speaker: Varak Chain-Magistrate
lines.text: You came seeking passage. I offer it. If the price offends you, ask the Gate to become generous.

lines.speaker: Varak Chain-Magistrate
lines.text: Fire does not fear water. It fears a current with judgment behind it.

lines.speaker: Mesha Gate-Scribe
lines.text: The first node is marked complete, but the stars disagree. Something is learning our symbols.

lines.speaker: Mesha Gate-Scribe
lines.text: The river bends uphill. Record that before you correct it. Miracles and wounds often wear the same light.

lines.speaker: Gate Silhouette
lines.text: Bring your measures. I have swallowed brighter laws.

lines.speaker: Aten Ra Titan Voice
lines.text: Then choke on this one.

lines.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
lines.text: Count the lanterns only after closing your eyes. The honest ones remain warm.

lines.speaker: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
lines.text: The reflection moved first. That means the Gate has stopped asking permission from cause.

lines.speaker: Foxfire Oath-Breaker
lines.text: Every promise wants a witness. I became the witness promises deserve.

lines.speaker: Celiane White-Vault Witness
lines.text: The lower notes are missing. The Choir continues because it has mistaken absence for consent.

lines.speaker: Celiane White-Vault Witness
lines.text: Do not run. The stair punishes urgency more reliably than malice.

lines.speaker: Vault Warden
lines.text: Mercy variable removed. Preservation purity restored.

lines.speaker: Celiane White-Vault Witness
lines.text: No. Preservation that cannot recognize the living has become another Collapse.
